name: Two-Seat Bouclé Sofa on Oak Plinth
description: A compact two-seat sofa with a low, softly rounded silhouette upholstered in ivory bouclé, with two loose seat cushions and two back cushions, resting on a recessed solid oak plinth base.
materials: Ivory bouclé wool upholstery with a dense looped pile over a rounded foam-and-frame body, two loose feather-wrapped seat cushions and two back cushions, recessed solid white oak plinth base with visible grain and a soft satin finish.
primaryColors: Ivory bouclé, warm pale oak plinth
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, label, contrast piping or printed pattern on the upholstery; never add legs, castors or metal feet, the base is a solid recessed oak plinth; never add throw pillows, blankets or props.
preservationNotes: Keep the same compact two-seat proportion, low rounded arm-and-back silhouette, exactly two loose seat cushions and two back cushions, and the recessed solid oak plinth base consistent across all five angles.
